issues.title: Tanzania still haunted by deadly election violence one year on
issues.title_en: Tanzania still haunted by deadly election violence one year on
issues.summary: One year after Tanzania’s disputed election, the scars of deadly violence remain. Critics still live in fear of abductions and arrests, while opposition supporters continue to face intimidation.
